title: Pwnston
html:
Pwnston is the hub for PvP fighting. It can only be reached from a portal in Townston on the PvP server; trying to reach it on any other server will give you an error message.

Portals

  • Practice Arena
  • PvP Arena

Inhabitants

  • Pwnston Commander
  • Pwnston Practice Master
  • Helpful Noobosaur
